subject: Inaugural Customer Intake — timeline, hosting plan & kickoff logistics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@healthspan.com>, Markus Vogel <m.vogel@healthspan.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Inaugural Customer Intake — timeline, hosting plan & kickoff logistics

Hi Dana / Markus —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To make the first week smooth we put together a short intake and proposed timeline so your team and ours are aligned before the kickoff. The high-level ask: pick a 90-minute kickoff (we recommend 60–90m) in the first two weeks of Sept where we will walk architecture, SSO/network requirements, and success milestones.

Proposed dates (PT): 
- Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:30 
- Thu Sep 9, 09:00–10:30 
- Wed Sep 15, 11:00–12:30

Draft agenda (we'll finalize once attendees confirmed):
1) Introductions + objectives (10m)
2) Architecture & data flow (20m)
3) Access matrix & SSO/KMS owners (15m)
4) Integration / network checklist (15m)
5) Implementation milestones & mutual action plan (20m)
6) Q&A / next steps (10m)

Pre-kickoff asks (please share before the meeting where possible):
- SSO / IdP owner name and point of contact
- Network contact for firewall/IP whitelisting
- Sample prompt/traffic shape (if available)
- Any procurement timeline constraints

I've attached our one-page intake checklist and a starter kickoff deck. Ben will lead the technical sections; Priyom will own the rollout milestones; Karthik will be our SME for onboarding automation.

Calendar hold + draft invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456
Drive assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-kickoff-assets

If you prefer a different cadence (two 45m sessions instead of one 90m), note that in your reply and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0198

Attachments: customer-intake-checklist.pdf, kickoff-slide-deck-v1.pptx

From: Dana Li <dana.li@healthspan.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Vogel <m.vogel@healthspan.com>, Support Team <support@healthspan.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inaugural Customer Intake — timeline, hosting plan & kickoff logistics

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. Sep 9 at 09:00 PT works best for our core team. We'll plan on a single 90-minute session. Attendees on our side: Dana Li (Product Lead), Markus Vogel (Platform Engineer), Priya Shah (Security), and Jamal Ortiz (DevOps). I'll forward any additional stakeholders if they RSVP.

A few notes: 
- Our IdP owner is Priya Shah (priya.shah@healthspan.com) — she may join or send a delegate if she's booked.
- For network we'll need your public egress IPs to pass to our firewall team; can you provide those in the next email?
- We will send a short traffic profile doc (sample prompt volumes) by Thu Aug 26.

Looking forward to it — please confirm the calendar invite and call bridge.

Best,
Dana
